scope: Proposed falsification criteria for the current project-design strategy register. These are not NFL facts, not results, and not approval to stake.
source_note: Official NFL links identify possible input sources only; they do not validate a strategy. Blank official-source URLs remain blank and are explicitly flagged.

strategies.name: Availability-surprise totals
strategies.supporting_evidence: A preregistered, timestamped series of official report changes (surprises, not injury levels) adds out-of-sample probability skill over the same-slate baseline, remains useful in a personnel-feature ablation, and is not fully explained by the executable market price.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: If the locked chronological evaluation shows no incremental proper-score skill over the declared baseline, its uncertainty interval includes no improvement, or the effect disappears in the no-personnel ablation, retire the hypothesis. Do not replace it with a fixed injury penalty.
strategies.missing_information: Immutable Wednesday-to-kickoff injury-report reads with fetch times and deltas; roster/IR events; verified game-day availability; market open/close with licence, venue and capture time; locked outcomes and inputs.
strategies.official_source_status: Input-source pointer only. The repository has selected dated reads, not a complete replayable series; no strategy effect is verified.
strategies.readiness: NOT VALIDATED — paper/design only; not eligible for staking.

strategies.name: Quarterback chain change
strategies.supporting_evidence: A dated, explicit starter-change announcement known before the decision cutoff adds forecast skill beyond the unchanged-rating baseline and the market after the market has had its documented response window.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: If the forward holdout shows no incremental skill after controlling for the market move, or the evidence timestamp is later than the decision cutoff, reject the claimed signal. Never substitute a depth-chart rank or jersey/experience proxy for an announced starter.
strategies.missing_information: Per-game announced-starter evidence with publication time; official game-day lineup/status evidence; point-in-time ratings; licensed market prices and a frozen decision cutoff.
strategies.official_source_status: Official news index is a review pointer only; each claim needs its dated article and timestamp. No complete linked event series or market archive is established here.
strategies.readiness: NOT VALIDATED — paper/design only; not eligible for staking.

strategies.name: Depth-gap pass-catchers
strategies.supporting_evidence: A verified starter absence followed by measured replacement participation and usage produces calibrated player-prop probabilities that improve on a role/market baseline in a chronological holdout.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: If actual participation/usage does not move as predicted, or the locked prop forecasts do not improve on the declared benchmark after price and settlement costs, reject the deficiency-to-usage mechanism. Do not infer snaps, routes or depth from jersey order.
strategies.missing_information: Rights-cleared all-32 starter evidence; verified inactives and actual participation; player-level snaps/routes/targets; player-prop opening/closing prices; operator settlement rules.
strategies.official_source_status: Official game-centre entry point only. It is not evidence of a full snap/route feed or of any prop price; coverage and reuse rights remain unresolved in the project registers.
strategies.readiness: NOT VALIDATED — missing player-level participation and prop-price evidence.

strategies.name: Short-week fatigue
strategies.supporting_evidence: A feature computed only from published kickoff/schedule facts improves future total-probability scores over an opponent-aware baseline and the authorized market benchmark, with the effect stable across chronological folds.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: If the feature adds no holdout skill after opponent, venue and season controls, or its sign changes across the preregistered folds, remove it rather than tune a new rest threshold on the same outcomes.
strategies.missing_information: Versioned published schedule facts joined to official game-level results; opponent-aware baseline; licensed total-price archive; frozen feature and evaluation window.
strategies.official_source_status: Official schedule link for fixture facts only; the linked 2026 week is an example, not a complete multi-season point-in-time corpus. No model effect is verified.
strategies.readiness: NOT VALIDATED — fixture context can be specified; market-relative skill is unmeasured.

strategies.name: Own-line residual
strategies.supporting_evidence: Probability forecasts and their fair lines are frozen with inputs before kickoff; residuals against a licensed, timestamped, de-vigged benchmark are calibrated and show positive prospective value with the applicable uncertainty bounds.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: If calibration fails the registered gate, residual direction does not improve proper scores versus the market, or the prospective CLV interval fails its registered criterion, stop promotion. A favorable backtest alone cannot change this decision.
strategies.missing_information: Licensed opening and closing prices by book/market/venue; timestamp and de-vig policy; retained forecast inputs and probabilities; prospective execution prices and settlement.
strategies.official_source_status: UNVERIFIED / NOT AVAILABLE — no market-price source is recorded in the project register as an official NFL source; Q-01 and the price policy remain open.
strategies.readiness: BLOCKED — price policy, licensed market archive and prospective evaluation are absent.

strategies.name: Two-leg availability stack
strategies.market: two correlated singles from the same game
strategies.supporting_evidence: A directly fitted joint probability, evaluated as one ticket with the operator's push/void rules, is calibrated on held-out games and supports value at an executable parlay price after vig and costs.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: If the joint model does not outperform its preregistered marginal-product control on held-out proper scores, or value vanishes after actual settlement rules and prices, reject the combo. Marginal multiplication is not evidence of a joint probability.
strategies.missing_information: Joint game-level outcomes, licensed leg and combo prices, operator push/void/void-leg rules, timestamped availability, and game-clustered prospective settlements.
strategies.official_source_status: UNVERIFIED / NOT AVAILABLE — NFL pages do not provide operator parlay prices or settlement contracts; no authorized source is registered.
strategies.readiness: BLOCKED — no validated joint-price and settlement evidence.

strategies.name: Cross-game parlay discipline
strategies.supporting_evidence: A directly validated joint model, compared with a frozen independence control and the executable ticket price, improves out-of-sample joint probability quality and value after fees and settlement rules.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: If dependence is not measured or the joint forecast fails to outperform the independence control and market benchmark on holdout data, keep the strategy at no-bet. Do not claim independence merely because legs come from different games.
strategies.missing_information: Timestamped leg and ticket prices; cross-game joint outcomes; same-window market snapshots; operator rules, fees, limits and void/push treatment.
strategies.official_source_status: UNVERIFIED / NOT AVAILABLE — no official NFL source publishes ticket prices or operator settlement rules; price-data policy is open.
strategies.readiness: BLOCKED — no joint ticket archive or validated dependence model.

strategies.name: Same-game QB/WR stack
strategies.supporting_evidence: A conditionally estimated joint distribution for quarterback and receiver outcomes is better calibrated on held-out games than marginal multiplication and is valuable at executable, rule-adjusted prices.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: If conditional joint forecasts fail the locked calibration/proper-score comparison, are unstable across held-out game clusters, or cannot beat the offered ticket price net of settlement rules, retire the stack rather than assume positive coupling.
strategies.missing_information: Player-level game outcomes with stable IDs; usage/participation evidence; offered prop and combo prices; operator settlement rules; enough independent games for uncertainty estimates.
strategies.official_source_status: Official game-centre entry point for game results only; it is not an official prop-price or complete usage archive. No joint evidence is validated here.
strategies.readiness: BLOCKED — no prop prices, complete player-level archive or validated joint probabilities.

strategies.name: Teammate negation pair
strategies.market: two receivers on the same team
strategies.supporting_evidence: The sign and size of conditional teammate outcome dependence are measured from game-level data with uncertainty, remain stable in holdouts, and a direct joint model improves over marginal multiplication at executable prices.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: If conditional dependence is not negative, is too uncertain, or changes sign across role/game-context holdouts, reject the negation thesis. Even a negative association is not an edge if the offered joint price already reflects it.
strategies.missing_information: Complete player-level outcomes and usage; timestamps/roles; direct joint-prop and market prices; settlement rules; predeclared conditioning variables.
strategies.official_source_status: Official game-centre entry point for results only; no complete target-share, prop-price or joint-settlement archive is registered.
strategies.readiness: BLOCKED — dependence sign, executable price and joint calibration are not established.

strategies.name: Rush/reception volume coupling
strategies.market: rush yards plus receptions for one back
strategies.supporting_evidence: As a measurement study only, verified player-level observations produce a conditional association whose sign, magnitude and uncertainty are stable across preregistered chronological holdouts after role and game-context controls.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: If the interval includes no association, the sign changes across holdouts, or the apparent relationship is explained by participation/role or game script, conclude the evidence is insufficient and do not create a bet rule.
strategies.missing_information: Player-level rush/reception outcomes; snaps, routes and role; direct prop prices; game-context inputs available before each forecast; retained source rights.
strategies.official_source_status: Official game-centre entry point only; current project registers do not establish complete snaps/routes or prop prices. The registered status is measurement-only.
strategies.readiness: MEASUREMENT ONLY — no bet rule or validated correlation.

strategies.name: Deficiency-driven alternate lines
strategies.supporting_evidence: A verified point-in-time replacement/availability event is followed by a reproducible residual in executable alternate-line prices, and the resulting forecast adds holdout value over the main line and market baselines.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: If timestamps show the market already incorporates the event, no consistent residual exists, or any apparent edge disappears after limits, vig and settlement rules, reject the repricing-lag thesis.
strategies.missing_information: All-32 verified lineup/availability evidence; point-in-time alternative-line prices and updates; book-specific limits and settlement rules; model probabilities and future outcomes.
strategies.official_source_status: UNVERIFIED / NOT AVAILABLE — no official NFL or licensed alternative-line price source is registered; Q-01 blocks evaluation.
strategies.readiness: BLOCKED — alternative-line price history and complete replacement evidence are absent.

strategies.name: Do-nothing control
strategies.supporting_evidence: The control emits no selection, no stake and no wager record; it provides the zero-exposure reference, not a candidate edge.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: Any non-zero selection, stake, settlement or reward is a control failure and invalidates the run until the implementation is corrected. The control should never be promoted as a betting strategy.
strategies.missing_information: A tested ledger assertion that the control remains at zero exposure in every evaluation run; no NFL data source is required for the rule itself.
strategies.official_source_status: NOT APPLICABLE — project control definition only; it asserts no NFL fact.
strategies.readiness: CONTROL ONLY — not a ranked or stakeable strategy.

strategies.name: Public-news echo control
strategies.supporting_evidence: As a negative control, its decisions are frozen at the same timestamp and scored beside the candidate. A candidate must add predictive skill beyond this public-news-only rule to support a novel-signal claim.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: If the candidate does not beat this control on the preregistered, held-out signal metric after the same price/cost treatment, conclude there is no demonstrated incremental information. If the control itself beats the market, investigate timing/leakage before interpreting it as an edge.
strategies.missing_information: Dated official news items; timestamped market prices before and after each item; matched candidate decisions; forward outcomes and a locked comparison.
strategies.official_source_status: Official news index only; each item and publication time must be individually recorded. The repository has no complete point-in-time news/price reaction archive.
strategies.readiness: NEGATIVE CONTROL — not a rewardable strategy; no tracked comparison is available.

strategies.name: Late-window origination
strategies.supporting_evidence: A preregistered late-window forecast, using only information captured before its cutoff, improves on the same model's earlier forecast and the authorized closing benchmark in prospective evaluation.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: If the late-window forecasts do not add holdout skill or executable CLV after accounting for capture latency and costs, or use data published after the stated cutoff, reject the late-window advantage.
strategies.missing_information: Immutable timestamped injury/news snapshots; early and late market prices; forecast/input hashes at both cutoffs; outcomes and prospective settlement.
strategies.official_source_status: Official report input pointer only; a current URL is not a historical snapshot series. No late-window advantage is measured.
strategies.readiness: NOT VALIDATED — requires a replayable event series and licensed price snapshots.

strategies.name: Availability-differential lean, hash-locked
strategies.market: game spread, against our own published number
strategies.supporting_evidence: Only the frozen preregistered version may be assessed: complete pre-kickoff official snapshots and forecast inputs replay exactly, and its prospective signal improves on the frozen controls under the declared scoring rule without changing the threshold or sample window.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: If the frozen version fails its preregistered forward comparison, uses any post-cutoff information, or cannot replay its inputs exactly, reject that version. Any new threshold or feature must receive a new registration before evaluation; never retune this sample.
strategies.missing_information: Complete immutable all-club report snapshots; verified availability/roster joins; timestamped market prices; full prospective forecast/decision ledger and settled outcomes.
strategies.official_source_status: Official injury-hub pointer only. The existing hash-lock is a project artifact, not proof of signal quality; the complete point-in-time series and price evidence remain absent.
strategies.readiness: PRE-REGISTERED, NOT VALIDATED — no promotion or staking claim is made.
